display_name: Tri SSL source-U channel consistency single source receiver
description: Four pre-fixed CFO/multipath U perturbations on single source RX; three seeds each. User selected setting after historical target exposure, where PL most exceeds Tri. Distinct from other owner cross-day and branch-gradient mechanisms; no target feedback for new matrix.

permissions.claim_scope: Phase1 terrestrial proxy; direct recognition; no future-date or in-orbit claim

checkpoint.initialization: Each seed own single-RX original Tri source-only scratch E20, then E10+E20
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: same m1-natural source contract and seed, source-only scratch
checkpoint.selection_rule: All 12 fixed final E50, all seven scenes; historical test exposure and target-based setting selection disclosed

expected_artifacts: 12 E50 checkpoints and source-U acceptance counters
all 12 seven-scene predictions frozen before scoring
paired per-scene Tri/PL, TX/RX/day corrected and missed, runtime and failure analysis

rows.method: Complete single-RX Tri SSL plus source-U five-branch consistency under tri-u-cfo
rows.purpose: Fixed physical perturbation versus single-RX same-seed Tri and ordinary PL; target >2 pp per scene
rows.seed_notes: model seed controls independent scratch model and source loader; augmentation value is fixed temporal permutation seed, original source augmentation schedules unchanged; fixed evaluation IQ reused
rows.optimizer: unchanged native optimizer and CENTER_UNITS Sinc mapping

notes: The two subsets are complementary; each branch mean is normalized within its subset, so changing subset changes which and how many terms receive the fixed weight.

Bounded phase and all REPL settings match the earlier full-phase candidate; the new ablation was conceived after that previously exposed Main split result and is developmental, not an independent blind test.
No target-truth or U-truth training; fixed E50 before target predictions; no target-driven checkpoint selection or rerun.
DURA-LU primary; raw and DURA-L secondary; cross_rx plus cross_both main and cross_date diagnostic; no leo_weak.
